# h11_fork_sync

Report issues: W3, R1.

**Source.** Hand-made SimOxide corpus model (`corpus/h11_fork_sync`, generated by refsim's `HandMade.java`). Licence: EPL-2.0 (SimOxide repository). `run.json` and `FEATURES.txt` are SimOxide metadata (`run.json` holds SimuLizar stop conditions; Slingshot uses the simulation time below).

## Model

A ForkAction with two synchronous forked behaviours joined by a SynchronisationPoint.

## Run with stock Slingshot

Import the folder into an Eclipse workspace with the Slingshot nightly. Create a *Slingshot Simulation* run configuration:

- Allocation Model: `h11_fork_sync.allocation`
- Usage Model: `h11_fork_sync.usagemodel`
- Monitor Repository: `h11_fork_sync.monitorrepository`
- Simulation tab: maximum simulation time **22 s**; EDP2, an in-memory repository.

The other model files are loaded through the references. Set the console log level to INFO to see the dispatched events and the handler errors (`An error occurred: …`).

The model draws random numbers. Stock Slingshot cannot be seeded, so times and values vary between runs; the effect described below does not depend on them.

## What to look for

- `NoSuchElementException` in `ForkBehaviorContextHolder.updateCurrentBehaviorIndex` (`ForkBehaviorContextHolder.java:66`), called from `getCurrentProcessedBehavior` (`:50`).
- The progress of one child advances whichever behaviour is current; the handler is disposed after the exception.

## Expected

Both behaviours run in parallel, each with its own cursor; the parent continues when both have finished.

## Observed (reference runner)

`observed/` holds the outputs of the SimOxide reference runner, deterministic mode, `-seed 10 -simTime 22` (appendix of `../../REPORT.md`): `errors.txt`, `measurements.csv`, `projection-m.jsonl`, `summary.json`.
`errors.txt` lists the handler exceptions (`exception: message | first Slingshot frame`), one per disposed handler; `measurements.csv` the EDP2 rows (`measuring_point,metric,time,value`); `projection*.jsonl` the dispatched model-level events (users, calls, jobs, measurements, SPD events; `projection-m.jsonl` without passed elements and jobs).

Headless (optional, from `reference/slingshot/`):

```sh
./run.sh --stock -model upstream-report/reproductions/h11_fork_sync -out /tmp/h11_fork_sync -simTime 22 -seed 1
./run.sh         -model upstream-report/reproductions/h11_fork_sync -out /tmp/h11_fork_sync-det -simTime 22 -seed 10   # deterministic
```
